test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'PORTAL' is coded as 'RQTVCN' and 'QUIET' is coded as 'SWKGV'. What is the code for 'SIMPLE' in the given code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : (2) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.

So,

 
• 'PORTAL' is coded as 'RQTVCN'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c2deba0bc8d3a144c6e0b8c6f19b9aa3e268447ba998a0f1a31234206e2bb594.png] 

And, 

 
• 'QUIET' is coded as 'SWKGV'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1fa4a9fcb7124390d84ee6ef802d8b4ee331d744431d22625193ea8fbf3c218.png] 

Similarly,

 
• 'SIMPLE' is coded as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36cad7628db1b955dd7b49a9ebf956583204c9b80444757878674aae50c69383.png] 

Hence, "**UKORNG**" is the correct answer.
